images.name: lightning_sheets
images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: LIGHTNING BLAST greyscale effect animation sprite sheet. Generate ONE image exactly 1536 x 1024 pixels. Flat PURE BLACK #000000 background, a black void: every background pixel exactly black. No grey fog, gradient, vignette, atmosphere, background lighting, glow, haze, bloom, radial falloff, blur or anti-aliasing. Six columns by four rows of 256 x 256 cells, 24 separate drawings centered in their cells with generous black margins, nothing touching cell edges or between cells. No labels, grid lines, text, borders or other objects.
Style: hand-painted small-native-size sprite effects, hard-edged shapes with hard stair-stepped edges as if drawn with a 1-px pencil at 64 px and enlarged 4x nearest-neighbour. Exactly FIVE values only: black #000000, dark grey #404040, mid grey #808080, light grey #C0C0C0, white #FFFFFF. Flat value steps, dark grey rim/interior holes, no outline strokes. White only for the tiniest spark or very center of a core, never entire shapes. Thin jagged lightning, hard steps, readable at 25 percent size. If light is needed use hard light-grey pixels, never glow. Original 1990s 16-bit hand-painted sprite effect vocabulary.
ROW 1 CAST, six frames left to right in time: small crackling arcs gather into a tight sparking ball at a point, growing brighter; frame 6 is a compact charged orb with short arcs leaping off it.
ROW 2 TRAVEL, six frames: jagged forked bolt segments facing RIGHT, thin zig-zag main stroke with 2-3 small forks and a few sparks trailing LEFT. Different zig-zag path in each frame for a loop.
ROW 3 IMPACT, six frames: frame 1 small bright fork star at strike point, no white disc; then 4-6 radiating jagged arcs burst outward; then arcs thin and break into sparks; final frame a few small drifting sparks. Make clear temporal progression through six separate centered cells.
ROW 4 RESIDUAL + SPARK: frames 1-4 flat scorched ground patches, ellipses wider than tall, short static arcs flickering over each, four loop variations of the same size. Frames 5-6 each contain ONE single small spark/arc fragment facing RIGHT, two variants.
Strict priority: pure black untouched background and gutters; greyscale five-value hard shapes; all four rows and all six columns; no soft luminous edges. Deliver the single complete sheet.

concerns: Task-specific style, background and layout conflict with the register card; followed the task-specific requirements.
Edges appear to contain intermediate greys; exact five-value palette and absence of anti-aliasing are unverified.
Background appears black visually; exact #000000 throughout is unverified.
